title: The Speakeasy (Rooftop HOT TUB!)
description:
Welcome to The Speakeasy. This spacious townhome and rooftop is less than a mile to Broadway and offers stunning views of the Nashville skyline, which you can admire from the rooftop’s hot tub.
 
If you’re looking for a comfortable place to relax and hang with friends in between your Nashville adventures, this is it. Come in, pour yourself a drink, and stay a while. For larger groups, message us about renting our other attached units!
